name: Generate and read QR codes
description: Turn a link or text into a QR image, or read the original content from a QR-code screenshot. Choose Generate or Read, then add your content.
generate: Turn text or a link into a QR code
marginHelp: Four-module quiet zone. Default correction level M; higher correction holds less text. Output grows if needed to preserve at least one pixel per module.
recognize: Read a QR code from an image
imageHelp: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image (up to 20 MiB and 16 megapixels).
drop: Drop an image here, or paste an image using your keyboard.
localHelp: One QR result per image. Decoded text stays here; links are never opened automatically. No camera, uploads or permissions.
tooLong: The content is too long for this correction level. Shorten it or choose a lower level.
invalidSize: Enter an integer image size from 128 to 2048 pixels.
invalidLevel: Choose L, M, Q or H correction.
notFound: No QR code was found. Try a clearer, uncropped image.
decodeError: The image could not be decoded.
imageType: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
